4a3c4185.title: AI Architect (Product Architecture)
4a3c4185.description:
**Company Description**

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

 **Job Description**

Sia is building AI-powered products and a GenAI practice, and we are a privileged partner of OpenAI and Anthropic. We need a hands-on architect who will own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products, from system design to production scale.

You will be the hands-on leader and technical authority for our internal teams and the person client tech teams hold accountable for the architecture.

**What you will do**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products: system design, service boundaries, data flow, APIs and non-functional requirements
* Design microservice-based systems that scale, deploy on Kubernetes, and run reliably in production
* Architect LLM solutions: RAG pipelines, agents, tool use (including MCP), memory and context management, and prompt management
* Define evaluation approaches for prompts, models and agents, including regression testing
* Build observability and traceability for AI: tracing of prompts, tool calls and agent steps, plus monitoring of latency, quality and cost
* Control AI cost and performance through model selection, token budgets, caching and routing
* Design for security and compliance: data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection defences and Responsible AI
* Write production code, build reference implementations and review critical code
* Set the team's agentic coding practices: AI-assisted workflows, review standards and quality gates
* Be accountable to client tech teams for architecture reviews and answers on scalability and security
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across internal teams

  
**Qualifications**

**Must have**

* 10+ years in software engineering, with recent years as an architect of production systems
* Strong Python and the ability to work across the stack
* End-to-end design of distributed, microservice-based systems at scale
* Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure), including managed LLM platforms such as Bedrock, Azure OpenAI or Vertex AI
* Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes
* LLM application experience (OpenAI and Anthropic APIs): RAG, vector databases and agents
* Experience with observability, traceability LLM evaluation and guardrails for AI systems
* Secure design for AI systems (privacy, PII, compliance)
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) and experience setting team practices around them
* Clear communication with the CTO, client engineers and business stakeholders

**Good to have**

* Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design
* Model and vendor strategy: build vs buy, multi-model routing, avoiding lock-in
* Reliability engineering for AI systems: SLOs, failover, rate limits and fallback when a provider is down
* Architecture governance: decision records, reviews and reference architectures
* Translating business needs into non-functional requirements

  
**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**  
  
**Equal Opportunity**  
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Decisions on hiring, promotion, remuneration and discipline are made solely on performance, competence, conduct and business needs.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

d7228af9.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Role Summary**

The Business Manager serves as a trusted partner and force multiplier to the Senior Vice President, managing the executive's calendar and operating rhythm, orchestrating operational and financial reviews across the SVP's portfolio, and ensuring leadership decisions are tracked through to closure. The role demands exceptional organisation, financial fluency, discretion, and the ability to represent the SVP's office credibly with senior internal and client stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Calendar & executive office management: Own end-to-end management of the SVP's calendar — prioritising and scheduling meetings across global time zones, resolving conflicts, protecting time for strategic priorities, and ensuring the SVP is prepared with agendas, briefing notes, and pre-reads for every engagement. Coordinate travel plans, client visits, leadership offsites, and town halls; manage logistics and follow-ups.

Operational reviews: Design and run the SVP's operating cadence — weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR) across delivery, and functional teams. Drive data collection from BU/account teams, capture minutes and decisions, and rigorously track actions to closure. Flag delivery, staffing, utilisation, and attrition risks early with recommended interventions.

Financial reviews: Coordinate and support financial reviews of the SVP's portfolio — revenue, bookings, margin, cost, and forecast accuracy. Work with Delivery Finance and BU leaders to consolidate P&L views, analyse variances against plan, prepare commentary for leadership reviews, and follow through on margin-improvement, DSO, and cost-optimisation actions.

Leadership communication & coordination: Act as the interface between the SVP's office and BU heads, sales leaders, corporate functions, and client executives. Draft executive communications, presentations, and talking points. Handle confidential and sensitive information with absolute discretion.

Strategic support: Support annual planning, target-setting, and strategic initiatives sponsored by the SVP. Conduct ad-hoc analyses (market, competition, account performance) and convert them into crisp, decision-ready summaries

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Experience: 8–12 years, with 3+ years supporting C-level / SVP-level executives in a business manager

BBA/MBA or equivalent, demonstrated experience managing an executive's calendar, cadence, and priorities in a large, matrixed organisation; strong financial acumen — able to read a P&L, interrogate forecasts, and prepare variance commentary; expert PowerPoint and Excel skills with strong executive storytelling; excellent written and verbal communication; superior stakeholder management, judgement, and confidentiality; high ownership and follow-through — known for closing loops without reminders; comfort with ambiguity, tight timelines, and global working hours.

**Desirable**

Prior experience in IT services, exposure to tools such as Power BI, Salesforce/CRM, SAP, and MS Teams/Outlook advanced scheduling; PMP or Six Sigma certification.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Business Process Management

----------------------

ff0376d0.title: Solutions Consultant
ff0376d0.description:
**About Us**

Zycus is a global leader in Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation.

At the core of Zycus’ platform is **Merlin AI**, an advanced AI-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real-time visibility and actionable insights.

Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as **Gartner, Forrester, and IDC** for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long-term business value.

With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement.

  
  

**We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced PreSales Solutions Consultant to join our PreSales team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SaaS solutions, a deep, hands-on understanding of AI and its application in enterprise business processes, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a PreSales Solutions Consultant, you will play a critical role in driving our sales efforts by providing technical and AI expertise, demonstrating our AI-powered solutions, and building strong relationships with potential clients.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and develop tailored solutions that use AI, AI agents and automation to address their needs.

* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations that showcase the value and capabilities of Zycus solutions, with a strong focus on Zycus’s AI capabilities, including Merlin AI agents and GenAI use cases.

* Translate AI capabilities into clear business outcomes, ROI and productivity gains for business and C-level audiences.

* Confidently address client questions on AI accuracy, data privacy, security, governance and responsible AI.

* Provide technical expertise and support during the sales process, including responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical inquiries, AI-specific sections included.

* Work closely with the product management and development teams to stay updated on the latest product features, enhancements and AI roadmap.

* Stay current on developments in AI and GenAI and on competitors’ AI offerings, and build a working understanding of the procurement industry, market trends and the competitive landscape.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, procurement professionals and IT teams.

* Assist in creating sales collateral, including presentations, case studies, whitepapers and AI use-case demos.

* Participate in industry events, conferences and webinars to promote Zycus solutions and generate leads.

**Skills & Experience Required:**

* 2–8 years of experience in a PreSales or Solutions Consulting role, preferably within the SaaS or enterprise software industry.

* Strong working knowledge of AI, including GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows, prompt engineering and RAG, and how they apply to enterprise business processes.

* Hands-on, regular use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini, with the ability to build and demonstrate practical AI use cases.

* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

* Proven track record of successfully supporting sales efforts and closing deals.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

**Good to Have:**

* Understanding of procurement processes and best practices, such as Source-to-Pay, Procure-to-Pay, Supply Chain or Finance.

* Experience with procurement or ERP platforms such as Zycus, SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Jaggaer or Oracle.

* AI certifications or coursework, such as AWS, Azure or Google AI certifications, or GenAI/ML courses.

* Exposure to automation, low-code tools, APIs or ERP integrations.

**Why Zycus?**

* **Recognized market leader:** Zycus was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Source-to-Pay Suites, and a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Source-to-Pay 2025 Vendor Assessment.
* **At the forefront of Agentic AI:** The platform runs on Merlin Agentic AI, with investments in intake technology, agentic AI (including autonomous negotiation for tail spend), and context-aware AI for security and control. You’ll be showing customers what’s next in enterprise AI, not just talking about it.
* **Shaping the future of procurement:** Zycus is moving beyond Source-to-Pay to Intake-to-Outcomes, defining the next generation of procurement.
* **Global exposure:** Work with large enterprise and Fortune 1000 customers across North America, Europe, the Middle East and APAC.
* **Customer-trusted:** Zycus was also recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2025 Gartner® Peer Insights™ “Voice of the Customer” for Source-to-Pay Suites.
* **Room to grow:** A fast-paced, innovation-driven environment where you’ll build deep AI and enterprise solutioning skills, with visible impact on deals and the product roadmap.

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

* Understands the SDLC and Agile, and how web, mobile, ERP and SaaS projects are scoped, built and maintained
* Can read and break down technical scope covering portals, ERP, mobile apps, APIs and integrations, cloud hosting, AI/ML and AMC/O&M
* Familiar with cloud basics (AWS, Azure, GCP), MeitY-empanelled cloud, hosting, backup and DR
* Knows common government IT requirements: GIGW and accessibility, CERT-In security audits, STQC, data localisation, SLA/uptime and penalty clauses, ISO 27001
* Can prepare effort and manpower estimates with the tech team and sanity-check a BOQ

**Good to Have**

* Background as a developer, business analyst or pre-sales engineer
* Experience with international RFPs (Middle East, UK, US)
* Can create basic architecture diagrams (draw.io, Lucidchart or similar)
* Uses AI tools to draft and review documents faster

**What We Offer**

* Salary:
  **₹2.5 to ₹6**
  **LPA**
  , plus an incentive on won bids
* Work directly with the founders, the BD head and the engineering team
* Clear path to a Bid Manager / Pre-Sales Lead role
* A fast-growing AI-first company with international clients

1292d25a.title: Partner Solutions Engineer (Mumbai)
1292d25a.description:
**Meet the Team**
The Solutions Engineering team is responsible for designing, implementing, and driving Cisco's Digital Resilience strategy for some of India's leading enterprises and strategic partners. We help organizations strengthen their cybersecurity posture by delivering innovative security architectures that enable secure connectivity, Zero Trust, cloud security, and cyber resilience.
  
  
As a trusted technical advisor, you'll work closely with Cisco Sales, channel partners, and customers to design, position, and implement Cisco's industry-leading Security portfolio while enabling partners to build long-term technical capabilities and deliver secure business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Partner Solutions Engineer – Security, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for strategic partners, driving technical strategy, solution development, and partner enablement across Cisco's Security portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Build and manage trusted technical relationships with strategic partners, serving as their primary security advisor.
* Design and present end-to-end Cisco Security architectures aligned with customer business and cybersecurity objectives.
* Lead technical workshops, customer presentations, demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on Cisco Security solutions.
* Develop Partner Technical Business Plans and drive technical readiness across Cisco's Security portfolio.
* Enable partners through technical training, architectural guidance, and best practices across Cisco Security technologies.
* Collaborate with Cisco Sales, Partner Account Managers, Channel Leaders, and Security Specialists to identify and drive strategic opportunities.
* Stay current on cybersecurity trends, competitive technologies, and emerging threats to influence partner strategy and customer security transformation.
* Support partners throughout the sales lifecycle, from opportunity qualification to post-sales technical guidance.
* Provide product and market feedback to Cisco Business Units to influence future product enhancements and solution positioning.
* Demonstrate business value and ROI by aligning Cisco Security solutions with customers' digital resilience and security transformation initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Security Consulting, Network Security, or Security Architecture.
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CCIE Security, or equivalent security certifications are highly preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise designing, positioning, and implementing Cisco Security solutions, including:
* Cisco Secure Firewall (Firepower/FTD)
* Cisco Secure Access (SASE)
* Cisco Umbrella
* Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* Cisco Duo
* Cisco Secure Endpoint
* Cisco Secure Email
* Cisco XDR
* Cisco Secure Network Analytics (Stealthwatch)
* Secure Service Edge (SSE)
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures, network security, cloud security, identity and access management, and secure access technologies.
* Experience working with Channel Partners, System Integrators, or Value-Added Resellers (VARs) to drive technical enablement and customer engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering executive presentations, customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on cybersecurity solutions.
* Strong understanding of Digital Resilience, Zero Trust, SASE, SSE, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and AI-driven Security architectures.
* Experience integrating Cisco Security solutions with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and security APIs using tools such as Python, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Excellent consultative selling, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and executive decision-makers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

c320e015.description:

Pre-Sales (Data, Analytics & AI), you will make an impact by leading and scaling our proposal, pursuit, and partner engagement function for Data, Analytics, and AI across strategic and complex client opportunities. You will be a valued member of the AI & Analytics (AIA) practice team and work collaboratively with sales, solution, delivery, and practice leadership.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Own opportunity qualification, account intelligence, and client research, and lead the end-to-end development of proposals, presentations, response documents, and sales collateral for strategic and complex pursuits.
* Drive pursuit governance, reviews, and submission timelines, ensuring compliance with bid processes and tracking progress, risks, dependencies, and action items with proactive escalation to leadership.
* Partner with sales, solution, delivery, and practice leadership to shape and defend compelling AI and Data narratives for client and leadership audiences.
* Build and curate reusable assets, case studies, and proposal repositories across the practice, while mentoring junior pre-sales talent and bringing structure and rigour to the pursuit lifecycle.
* Maintain cadence with partner alliance points of contact (such as AWS, Azure, and Databricks) to align proposals with joint solutions and co-sell motions, and support partner-aligned RFPs correctly tagged for partner funding and co-sell credit.

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Experience in Pre-Sales, Business Development, Bid Management, or Proposal Management, with a proven track record leading large and complex RFP responses.
* Experience managing stakeholders up to senior leadership and client CXO levels, and owning solutioning narratives for Data, Analytics, AI, and Generative AI opportunities.
* Strong analytical, storytelling, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting to leadership.
* Exposure to partner ecosystems (such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and GCP) and funding or co-sell motions, plus the ability to manage and develop a small team of pre-sales professionals.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools, with exposure to CRM or pursuit-tracking platforms, and the ability to thrive and lead in a fast-paced, global environment.

**These will help you stand out**

* Hands-on experience designing or deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions to improve pursuit management, proposal development, research, knowledge management, and sales productivity.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

73c6ad59.title: Solution Engineer
73c6ad59.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  
  

* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
  
  

* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

8c7677ba.title: Technical Program Manager, Fleet and Supply Chain Intelligence
8c7677ba.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 13 years of experience in modern data toolsets, advanced analytics, and cloud-native environments, including enterprise data management and market data frameworks.
* 10 years of Technical Program Management experience leading full project lifecycles, with proficiency in SQL querying, data visualization, AI prompt engineering, and process automation.
* 3 years of experience configuring, analyzing, or managing modules within SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience with enterprise platforms, specifically the configuration, implementation, or upgrade of tier-one supply chain systems, applications, or data center operations.
* Exceptional Agile leadership operating as a Product Owner or Scrum Master to manage complex, cross-functional, and multi-stakeholder dependencies.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you will lead a high-performing team of Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and engineers responsible for the strategic design, delivery, and optimization of Fleet Management and Supply Chain planning technology ecosystem. In this dual-impact role, you will act as a people manager and a strategic advisor, bridging the gap between complex Cloud data center investment strategies and scalable technical architecture. You will own the technology roadmap for critical platforms supporting front, middle, or back-office functions—ensuing our systems seamlessly support the scalable data center operations. **Company Description**

**About us:**

You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!

 **Job Description**

Solution Architect – Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory & CyberArk PAM

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and drive the identity and privileged access management (PAM) architecture across a hybrid Microsoft Entra ID and On‑Prem Active Directory environment, with deep expertise in CyberArk PAM solutions.

This role owns the end‑to‑end design, integration, and governance of identity and privileged access controls, ensuring alignment with enterprise IAM strategy, Zero Trust principles, and regulatory requirements. The architect will work closely with IAM engineers, security teams, infrastructure, application owners, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Identity & Access Architecture (Entra ID & Active Directory)

* Define and own the hybrid identity architecture across Microsoft Entra ID and On‑Prem Active Directory
* Design secure authentication and authorization models:
  + Conditional Access
  + MFA and authentication strengths
  + Passwordless authentication (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business)
* Define hybrid identity patterns including Entra Connect and authentication models
* Establish identity standards and guardrails aligned with Zero Trust architecture

Privileged Access Management (CyberArk)

* Define and drive Privileged Access Management (PAM) architecture using CyberArk, aligned with the enterprise IAM strategy
* Lead the design and implementation of privileged access controls across:
  + Servers
  + Endpoints
  + Databases
  + Applications
* Integrate PAM with Access Management capabilities:
  + SSO
  + MFA
  + Microsoft Entra ID
* Integrate CyberArk with the broader enterprise security ecosystem, including:
  + SIEM platforms
  + ITSM tools
* Define and enforce least privilege and Zero Trust principles across infrastructure and endpoints
* Drive secrets management strategy for applications using:
  + CyberArk Conjur
  + CyberArk CCP
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to enable secure credential management and automation
* Provide architectural guidance for CyberArk EPM‑based endpoint privilege control

Solution Design & Integration

* Design secure integrations between:
  + Entra ID
  + Active Directory
  + CyberArk PAM platforms
  + On‑prem, cloud, and SaaS applications
* Define application onboarding patterns:
  + SSO and federation
  + Privileged access flows
  + Secrets consumption models
* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, and auditable

Architecture, Strategy & Governance

* Define the PAM roadmap and maturity model, aligned with IAM and enterprise security strategy
* Establish standards for:
  + Privileged account onboarding
  + Password rotation
  + Session recording and monitoring
* Drive risk reduction initiatives, including:
  + Removal of standing administrative access
  + Credential hardening
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance for privileged access:
  + SOX
  + ISO
  + GDPR
* Participate in threat modeling, security reviews, and risk assessments

Leadership & Collaboration

* Act as the design authority for identity and PAM solutions
* Partner with:
  + IAM and PAM engineering teams
  + Security architecture
  + Cloud and infrastructure teams
  + Application owners
* Review and approve technical designs and implementations
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to senior engineers

Required Skills & Expertise

CyberArk & PAM

* Strong expertise in CyberArk PAS, EPM, CCP, and Conjur
* Deep understanding of privileged access risks, controls, and governance models
* Hands‑on experience designing and integrating PAM solutions at enterprise scale

Microsoft Identity

* Microsoft Entra ID (P2)
* Conditional Access and Identity Protection
* Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
* Entra Connect and hybrid authentication
* Active Directory security and tiered admin models

Operating Systems & Platforms

* Strong knowledge of:
  + Windows privilege models
  + Unix/Linux privilege models
  + Active Directory security concepts

Automation & Integration

* Hands‑on experience with automation and integration using:
  + REST APIs
  + PowerShell
  + Python
* Experience integrating PAM into CI/CD and automated workflows

Security & Architecture

* Zero Trust architecture
* Least privilege enforcement
* Identity‑based and privileged access attack techniques and mitigations

Nice to Have

* Exposure to cloud PAM use cases across:
  + Azure
  + AWS
  + GCP
* Experience with DevOps and cloud‑native environments
* CyberArk certifications:
  + Sentry
  + CDE
* Microsoft security certifications (SC‑300, AZ‑500)
* CISSP or equivalent

 **Qualifications**

Graduation OR Post Graduation

7757222e.title: Solution Architect, SAP Supply Chain Planning DMC
7757222e.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Job Title: Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
The
**Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving SAP-enabled digital manufacturing solutions. The role covers SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), SAP Manufacturing Execution (ME), and related SAP PP, EWM, QM, MM-IM, and PM capabilities.
  
  
Working closely with Manufacturing, Operations, and Plant IT, the role delivers reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions that provide real-time operational visibility, enable intelligent production planning, and connect shop-floor activities with enterprise processes. The position plays a key role in improving productivity, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead end-to-end SAP digital manufacturing initiatives from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement solutions across SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud, SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM-IM/PM, and SAP ECC/S4HANA/EWM integration points.
* Collaborate with production, quality, maintenance, and logistics teams to map business processes to SAP capabilities (e.g., production planning, order execution, batch management, quality inspection, asset management, stock transfer).
* Design and configure real-time shop-floor dashboards, KPIs, alerts, and analytics to enable data-driven decision making.
* Integrate SAP digital manufacturing solutions with MES, ERP, IoT platforms, and third-party systems (e.g., PLCs, historians, SCADA, and OT data sources).
* Lead data modelling efforts for master data, bill of materials, routings, work centres, and production orders to support manufacturing operations.
* Define and execute testing strategies (functional, integration, regression) and support user acceptance testing.
* Establish governance for change management, version control, security, access controls, and data quality within SAP solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to project teams, business analysts, and end-users.
* Prepare and manage project plans, budgets, risk registers, and status communications to stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and training materials for end users.
* Stay current with SAP product roadmaps, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, ISO) impacting manufacturing operations.

**Who You Are**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* At least 5+ years of experience implementing or sustaining SAP-based manufacturing solutions.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC) and/or SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII); knowledge of SAP ME and SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM-IM/PM is highly desirable.
* Strong integration experience between SAP ECC, S/4 Hana, EWM using SAP Clound connector with SAP DM and MES/OT systems, including API design, middleware, and data mapping.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (discrete, batch, process) and shop-floor realities.
* Experience with real-time analytics, dashboards, and KPI design for manufacturing operations.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance in manufacturing IT environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP certifications relevant to digital manufacturing (e.g., SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/PM, SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud).
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration patterns and SAP Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of OT/IT convergence, IIoT, OPC/UA, MQTT, and data historian architectures.
* Programming or scripting skills (e.g., SQL, ABAP, JavaScript) to support custom developments or data extraction.
* Experience in GMP/AML/ISO-compliant manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading change management, user adoption, training, and enablement activities.
* Certification or formal training in IoT, manufacturing analytics, data science, or a related discipline.

Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Strong stakeholder-management, facilitation, and communication abilities.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across business, IT, engineering, and operations teams in a global environment.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented, and committed to clear, accurate documentation.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple initiatives while maintaining delivery focus.
* Adaptability and willingness to continuously learn as SAP capabilities and manufacturing technologies evolve.

**Work Environment And Other Requirements**

* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required; typical travel is approximately 10–20%, depending on project needs.
* Ability to work periodically on-site at manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and support initiatives across multiple locations and time zones.

Opportunity and Impact the SAP Digital Manufacturing Professional enable smarter, more connected manufacturing with improved throughput, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance. This role is pivotal in transforming operational data into actionable insights and sustaining a competitive advantage through digital manufacturing excellence.
  
  
**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

157bf7f5.title: Solution Architect, Public Sector India
157bf7f5.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.
  
  
**Purpose**
Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.
  
  
**India Public Sector Context**

* Who we serve: central ministries, state governments, PSUs, regulators, smart city and urban bodies, and digital public infrastructure programs.
* Where ServiceNow fits: citizen grievance and service delivery, case management, GRC, IT operations for large government estates, workflow over legacy systems, and AI-assisted operations.
* How deals happen: tender-led (RFP/RFQ, GeM), SI and partner-led bids, price-sensitive evaluation, long sales cycles.
* What shapes the design: data residency, MeitY-empanelled cloud, CERT-In and security audits, the DPDP Act, and Make in India preferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Public Sector BD & Sales Leads for the GTM plan for Central and State Ministries, Public Sector Banks and Higher Education / Universities
* Lead architecture sessions with government CIO, IT, and NIC teams, translating program goals into actionable blueprints.
* Own the technical response on RFPs and tenders: compliance matrices, architecture, sizing, and clarifications.
* Build and run proof of concepts and demos across AI, workflow, and integration that prove value in days, not weeks.
* Design within government constraints: hosting, data localisation, security, AI governance, and integration with legacy and national platforms.
* Co-sell with SIs and partners on solution scope, bid strategy, and delivery handoff.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Consultants, Specialists, Product, and Legal on deal strategy and risk.
* Work with regional AI experts to shape and validate AI solutions and proof of concepts.
* Build reusable India public sector assets: reference architectures, AI use-case patterns, an RFP response library, and a compliance FAQ.
* Mentor Solution Consultants on public sector sales motions.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8-10 years of exclusive public sector pre-sales experience (government, PSU, or SI/OEM on government programs).
* Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
* AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.
* Expertise in AI architecture, workflow automation, data & analytics, and integration frameworks
* Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.
* Depth in enterprise workflow or ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred; fast ramp expected if not), plus integration, API, data, and automation architecture.
* Trusted advisor on deal strategy, not only demos.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, NCR (New Delhi), with regular travel to government offices

**Good To Have**

* Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including Now Assist and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with MeitY empanelment, GeM, CERT-In, the DPDP Act, and the IndiaAI Mission.
* Existing government and SI network.

**What We Offer**

* A structured AI upskilling path to expert level over 6-12 months.
* Direct access to regional AI experts for design, proof of concepts, and deal support.
* Ground-floor ownership of a new vertical in India.

TR21

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

e7b0f120.title: Sr. Application Architect
e7b0f120.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

d2fd52d1.description:
**About Antier Solutions**
Antier Solutions is a technology company specialising in Blockchain, Web3 and emerging technologies, with a growing focus on Artificial Intelligence and enterprise AI solutions.
  
  
As we expand our AI capabilities and strengthen our position in the enterprise technology landscape, we are looking for a senior technology leader who can bring deep AI expertise, architectural excellence, strategic thinking and strong client-facing capabilities to the organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
Antier Solutions is looking for an accomplished
**AI Solution Architect**
who brings together deep technical expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI and enterprise architecture with proven experience in technical presales, solution consulting and technology leadership.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has progressed from a strong software engineering or AI engineering foundation into solution architecture, technical consulting or technology leadership, and can operate confidently across both engineering and business environments.
  
  
This is a strategic role requiring someone who can independently lead enterprise AI engagements, architect complex solutions, guide engineering teams, influence client decisions and contribute to business growth through technically sound and commercially viable solutions.
  
  
Beyond executing individual assignments, the individual will be expected to bring an independent technology perspective, evaluate existing AI capabilities, identify opportunities for improvement and recommend what the organization should build, adopt, strengthen or explore to establish and scale its AI practice.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with the CTO, senior leadership, business development, enterprise clients and engineering teams, acting as a key technical authority for AI solutioning and architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Solution Architecture & Engineering Leadership
* Design and define end-to-end architectures for enterprise AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
* Architect solutions involving LLMs, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI orchestration, APIs, vector databases, data pipelines and enterprise integrations.
* Evaluate AI models, frameworks, tools, cloud platforms and infrastructure based on technical suitability, scalability, performance and cost.
* Define architecture strategies for cloud, hybrid and on-premise AI deployments.
* Assess system security, reliability, latency, performance, maintainability and long-term scalability.
* Guide engineering teams on architecture decisions, technology selection, development approaches and implementation challenges.
* Review technical designs, validate engineering approaches and establish architecture standards and best practices.
* Provide technical direction on complex AI engineering and enterprise system design challenges.
* Enterprise Presales & Technical Consulting
* Independently lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise clients, CTOs, business leaders and technical stakeholders.
* Understand business objectives, existing technology environments, operational challenges, data availability and technical requirements.
* Identify opportunities where AI, ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation can create measurable business value.
* Translate business requirements into technically robust, scalable and commercially viable AI solutions.
* Lead technical solutioning from initial client discussions through architecture definition, technical validation and opportunity closure.
* Present and defend proposed AI architectures, technology choices, implementation approaches and solution trade-offs.
* Lead technical presentations, demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (POCs) and solution workshops.
* Prepare and review technical proposals, solution documents, architecture diagrams, scope definitions and implementation approaches.
* Participate in RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires and enterprise solution evaluations.
* Collaborate with business development and sales teams to strengthen technical positioning and support enterprise business acquisition.
* Communicate complex AI concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* AI Technology Strategy & Organisational Growth
* Evaluating existing AI capabilities, engineering practices and technology positioning will be appreciated
* Recommend strategic AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and capabilities that the organisation should develop or adopt.
* Identify opportunities to build differentiated AI products, reusable components, accelerators and enterprise AI solutions.
* Define recommendations for strengthening AI engineering capabilities, architecture standards and delivery maturity.
* Identify emerging AI trends, technologies and market opportunities relevant to Antier's long-term technology direction.
* Advise senior leadership on technology investments, architectural choices, AI adoption strategies and capability development.
* Contribute to the organisation's AI technology roadmap and long-term engineering strategy.
* Identify opportunities for technological convergence between AI, Blockchain, Web3 and decentralised systems.
* Bring an independent perspective to technology decisions and proactively challenge approaches that may not be technically or commercially sustainable.
* Client Discovery, Estimation & Delivery Alignment
* Assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, dependencies, risks and delivery requirements.
* Estimate development effort, resource requirements, team composition, infrastructure needs and project timelines.
* Work closely with engineering and delivery leadership to validate estimates and proposed implementation approaches.
* Define project scope, assumptions, exclusions, milestones and expected deliverables.
* Ensure alignment between client expectations, proposed architecture, engineering capabilities and delivery commitments.
* Facilitate technical handovers from presales and solutioning to implementation teams.
* Support engineering teams in resolving architectural dependencies and critical technical challenges.
* Maintain technical accountability throughout the solution lifecycle.
* AI Innovation, Research & Technical Mentorship
* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, orchestration technologies and enterprise architecture approaches.
* Drive technical experimentation, architecture validation and development of AI proof-of-concepts.
* Establish engineering practices around model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, optimisation, security and governance.
* Guide and mentor senior engineers, technical leads and AI engineering teams.
* Encourage engineering innovation, technical ownership and continuous improvement.
* Build reusable architectural patterns and frameworks to accelerate enterprise AI solution development.
* Represent the organisation in senior technical discussions, client workshops and strategic technology engagements.

**Required Experience & Technical Expertise**

* 10+ years of overall experience across software engineering, AI engineering, solution architecture, enterprise technology consulting or technical leadership.
* At least 5 years of substantial experience in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, AI solution development or AI architecture.
* Strong preference for candidates with significant experience in AI-first companies, AI product organisations or dedicated AI engineering businesses where AI is the primary technology and business focus.
* Strong foundation in software engineering, system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, microservices and cloud architecture.
* Deep understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and enterprise AI applications.
* Practical experience with technologies such as Python, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases and cloud AI services.
* Demonstrated experience designing, developing or architecting production-grade AI applications and scalable enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of AI deployment, MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, security, performance and optimisation.
* Proven experience in technical presales, enterprise solution consulting, client-facing architecture or strategic technology engagements.
* Ability to independently conduct technical discovery, design architectures, assess feasibility, estimate implementation effort and present technical recommendations.
* Experience handling enterprise proposals, solution presentations, POCs, RFPs/RFIs and technical negotiations.
* Ability to guide engineering teams, validate technical decisions and provide architectural direction.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence or a related engineering discipline.
* Graduates from Tier-1 engineering institutions will be strongly preferred.
* Significant experience in AI-first technology companies, AI product organisations or dedicated AI engineering businesses.
* Experience building AI-powered products, platforms or enterprise solutions from initial architecture through production deployment and scaling.
* Experience engaging with enterprise clients across India, GCC, UK, Europe or other international markets.
* Experience advising senior leadership on AI technology strategy, architecture and engineering capability development.
* Exposure to Blockchain, Web3, DeFi, smart contracts or decentralised applications is a great add on
* Relevant certifications in AI, Machine Learning, cloud architecture or advanced technology domains is good to have

**Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for a technology leader who combines the depth of an experienced AI engineer, the architectural capabilities of an enterprise Solution Architect and the commercial understanding of a senior Presales Consultant.
  
  
**The Ideal Individual**

* Has developed or worked in substantial expertise in an AI-first technology environment
* Can independently architect, evaluate and defend complex AI solutions at an engineering and enterprise level.
* Can confidently lead technical presales engagements, understand client business requirements and convert them into viable AI solutions.
* Has the maturity to guide senior engineering teams and influence technical decisions.
* Brings a forward-looking technology perspective and can contribute beyond the boundaries of an assigned project or client engagement.

**This opportunity is suited to professionals who are ready to move beyond individual solution delivery and take ownership of broader AI technology direction, enterprise solution architecture and strategic engineering growth.**

2d0aa410.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience as an Enterprise/Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, or Technical Lead designing and delivering enterprise systems in a cloud environment.
* Experience with healthcare interoperability, data standards, and regulatory/compliance frameworks across North America and EMEA markets.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Computational Biology or a related technical field.
* Experience designing hybrid enterprise architectures that combine business rules and data pipelines with multi-agent orchestration and LLM reasoning to meet strict accuracy, auditability, and latency SLAs.
* Architectural and implementation experience with Google Cloud’s AI, Data, and Healthcare stack (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini, Agent Development Kit (ADK), BigQuery, and Cloud Healthcare API).
* Demonstrated ability to be a SME, advising executive stakeholders, aligning product requirements documents and statements of work, and guiding cross-functional and global systems integrator engineering teams through code reviews, technical debugging, and problem-solving.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect in GSD Industry Solutions (Healthcare and Life Sciences), you will combine deep HCLS domain fluency with direct Google Cloud and Generative/Agentic AI engineering expertise to take qualified, complex customer opportunities from defining requirements and architecting solutions through coding, rapid prototyping, implementation, and production rollout.
  
  
You will engage directly with customer C-suite, product, clinical, and engineering leaders to architect and build end-state cloud and agentic systems. Operating in a capacity, you will establish technical blueprints on strategic industry priorities, provide technical direction across cross-practice and partner delivery teams, write and review production-grade code for core architectural components aligned to the target architecture, and codify field-proven patterns into repeatable reference architectures, industry agents, and service offerings.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with customer product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders to translate complex healthcare and life sciences requirements into production-grade architectures and directly drive implementation engineering production-level code, building core agentic/RAG and data pipelines.
* Serve as the lead architectural advisor on strategic engagements, guiding design decisions, unblocking complex engineering challenges through coding, debugging, and performance tuning, data, infrastructure, and AI practices to ensure interoperability.
* Define and build standardized reference architectures, reusable Agentic workflows, and technical blueprints aligned to priority HCLS transformation themes.
* Architect and implement verifiable AI evaluation frameworks, PHI data-protection boundaries, source-citation grounding, human-in-the-loop governance into customer solutions.
* Collaborate with Google Cloud Product Management, Customer Engineering, and Regional Consulting teams to scope strategic engagements.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. 6582e0bc.title: Senior Forward Deployed Architect, Generative AI
6582e0bc.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
NVIDIA is looking for a Forward Deployed Architect to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance across AI Accelerator engagements with AI Native organizations, NeoCloud Providers, and ISVs. You'll advise on architecture and integration, define what good looks like, and bring learnings back to inform the DSX product roadmap. This role is engaged when standard product capabilities are not enough and the work needs to be specialized. Curious about novel hardware before it has a playbook? Excited to define how new platforms get used at scale? Our team works alongside customers and partners on infrastructure problems no one has solved yet, helping teams adopt NVIDIA technology the right way and shaping how new AI workloads get deployed.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Cross-Account Technical Leadership. Provide architectural direction across strategic engagements where standard capabilities are not enough and advanced implementation, optimization, or integration customization is needed.
* Outcome-Focused Implementation. Help customers integrate the right components to deliver on their outcomes. Where DSX software fits, advise on adopting it the right way. Where it doesn't, help them succeed with the right alternative and bring the gap back to product and engineering.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership. Dive into complex technical challenges hands-on when needed to solve critical problems, validate architectures, or prove out solutions.
* Strategic Initiative Ownership. Lead technically demanding programs end to end, including third-party performance benchmarking across hardware and workloads.
* Pattern Identification and Knowledge Sharing. Identify common challenges and solution patterns across engagements. Share findings with internal teams and the broader AI community.
* Technical Standardization. Develop standardized approaches, reference architectures, and structured guidance rooted in patterns from successful engagements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with product, engineering, and other customer-facing NVIDIA teams so what we learn in the field informs internal strategy and capabilities.
* Strategic Architecture. Design technical strategies for advanced AI workloads (distributed training, large-scale inference, model and pipeline optimization, MLOps) that apply across multiple customers and partners.
* New Hardware Enablement. Help develop new infrastructure patterns and playbooks for the latest NVIDIA hardware as it lands with customers and partners.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technical roles such as solutions architecture, ML engineering, technical product management, or technical consulting across multiple customers or projects. Alternatively, 5+ years of specialist-level experience working at the frontier of AI infrastructure.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Systems thinking with the ability to understand customer outcomes and translate them into clear technical requirements and architectures.
* Willingness to prototype, implement, validate, and troubleshoot hands-on when needed to solve critical problems or prove out approaches.
* A solid technical foundation in the technologies AI infrastructure is built on, especially Linux systems administration.
* A self-directed learner who can ramp on brand new technologies and unfamiliar technical domains independently.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and multi-functional collaborators.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Solutions architecture or technical consulting background across multiple customer engagements simultaneously, with experience bringing novel AI hardware or frameworks to production with frontier AI Native organizations, hyperscalers, NeoClouds, or ISVs.
* A foundational cloud or distributed systems background built at hyperscaler scale.
* A public technical voice: blog posts, talks, open-source contributions, or reference work that shows depth and opinion.
* Hands-On Technical Expertise in one or more of: NVIDIA Stack (CUDA, NeMo, Triton, TensorRT, NIM, DGX Cloud, and the broader DSX software portfolio), Inference Systems (large-scale inference with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang, prefill-decode disaggregation, performance optimization across hardware), Training Systems (distributed training, model and pipeline optimization, open-source generative AI frameworks), Infrastructure (SLURM, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, distributed computing frameworks, rack-scale systems, multiple CSP or NCP cloud environments), and Observability and Automation (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GPU performance monitoring).
