6b06d5b4.title: Managed Services Consultant - Specialist
6b06d5b4.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**

**Role Summary**

Lead strategic managed services engagements for enterprise and high-impact Sprinklr   CCaaS   customers, driving architecture, transformation, and long-term value realization. Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and shape scalable, future-ready customer service solutions across digital and voice ecosystems.

**What   You ll   Do**

* Define and lead     **best-practice solution architecture and blueprinting**     for complex Sprinklr   CCaaS   environments.

* Govern and evolve     **core configuration architecture**   , ensuring alignment to enterprise design standards, supportability, and long-term scalability.

* Architect enterprise-grade solutions across     **omnichannel engagement, voice/contact   center   workflows, automation, AI, routing, IVR, and case orchestration**   .

* Design and   optimize       **advanced routing strategies**     including multi-skill routing, real-time prioritization, queue balancing, and cross-channel work orchestration.

* Establish scalable     **bot, automation, and AI strategies**   , including conversational design, NLP optimization, deflection programs, and bot-to-agent transitions.

* Drive     **platform adoption and value realization strategies**     across business units, ensuring consistent and effective platform usage at scale.

* Define and influence     **customer contact   center   operational metrics**     such as SLA performance, containment, cost-to-serve, CSAT, productivity, and customer experience outcomes.

* Identify   and lead     **transformation opportunities**     using AI, automation, workflow redesign, and service optimization to improve ROI and operational maturity.

* Architect and oversee     **complex API, CRM, telephony, and enterprise system integrations**     to support end-to-end service ecosystems.

* Partner with     **Sales, Customer Success, and leadership teams**     to drive strategic growth, new business opportunities, expansion, and platform value discussions.

* Lead     **training, onboarding, and enablement strategies**     for large agent populations, admin teams, and operational stakeholders to ensure adoption of best practices and standardized operating models.

* Act as a     **trusted advisor to executive stakeholders**   , shaping platform strategy, CX transformation, and future-state operating models.

* Mentor Lead and Senior consultants,   establish   delivery standards, and drive reusable best practices across managed services engagements.

* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to influence     **platform enhancements, innovation priorities, and solution evolution**   .

**What Makes You Qualified**

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in     **managed services,   CCaaS , solution consulting, or customer service technology transformation**   .

* Deep   expertise   in     **Sprinklr   CCaaS**   , including digital, voice, omnichannel, automation, and AI capabilities.

* Strong experience with     **contact   center   architecture, IVR, routing strategies, automation frameworks, case orchestration, and service governance**   .

* Strong understanding of     **telephony and cloud contact   center   technologies**   , including VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.

* Experience leading     **API, CRM, telephony, and enterprise workflow integrations**   .

* Proven ability to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions and transformation roadmaps.

* Strong executive communication, consulting, and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience leading     **enterprise transformation programs**     across customer experience and contact   center   environments.

* Advanced exposure to     **AI-led service transformation, automation strategy, and digital deflection models**   .

* Experience with     **social and digital engagement ecosystems**     is a plus.

* CCaaS   certifications such as     **Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya**     preferred.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic, consultative, and technically deep.

* A trusted advisor who can influence senior stakeholders and customer strategy.

* Strong at connecting platform capabilities to business outcomes and transformation goals.

* A mentor and thought leader who raises delivery standards across teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Strong growth   in platform adoption, retention, and expansion across strategic accounts.

* Successful delivery of scalable, transformation-led solutions with measurable business value.

* Recognition as a strategic advisor internally and externally.

* Meaningful contribution to best practices, organizational maturity, and customer advocacy.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off - it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. **Role****:** Program Manager

**Employment Type**: Full Time

**About the Role**

At Pixxel, our Program Managers are the custodians of mission success. They own and drive every aspect of a mission — from planning and budgeting, to risk management, reviews, and reporting — ensuring that our spacecraft are launched on time, on budget, and in alignment with mission objectives. This role requires a rare mix of technical understanding, operational excellence, and stakeholder management to keep missions moving seamlessly from concept to successful on-orbit operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Primary Ownership Areas:

* Mission Budgets: Own mission budgets end-to-end, including recalculations, rebalances, reconciliations with finance, and tracking actual spends across the mission lifecycle.

* Risk Management: Own and update the missionʼs risk register; regularly assess technical and non-technical risks; ensure timely decisions on acceptance/rejection of risks.

* Timelines & Milestones: Define, plan, and own mission timelines in coordination with systems engineering; set milestones and drive teams to achieve them within the cycle; regularly track backlog, open tickets, and deliverables.

* Vendor/Partner Coordination: Track and manage critical path items with vendors/partners; remove roadblocks in vendor selection and execution; ensure timely delivery of external inputs.

* Mission Reviews: Plan and orchestrate reviews SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR, etc.) to ensure alignment of technical understanding and momentum towards milestones.

* Updates & Reporting: Deliver clear, actionable, and regular updates to internal and external stakeholders; provide decision-enabling reports and summaries.

* Proposals: When not deployed on a live mission, support the development of proposals for upcoming mission opportunities.

**Secondary / Support Areas:**

* Launch Coordination: Work with launch service providers on schedules, payload integration, and compatibility.

* Technical Oversight: Provide oversight across the mission lifecycle, from design reviews to integration and testing.

* Quality Profile: Partner with QA/QC to flag design/manufacturing issues early, balancing optimization with cost/time efficiency.

* Compliance: Ensure regulatory requirements (frequency, imaging, operations licenses) are met in time.

* Documentation: Support systems engineering and subsystems in maintaining accurate and timely documentation.

* Mission Objectives: Ensure mission objectives and Level 1 requirements are tracked from planning through on-orbit operations, in collaboration with systems engineering.

* Purchasing/Payments/Logistics: Coordinate with finance and supply chain to ensure payments, purchases, and logistics align with mission needs.

**Success Criteria**

The performance of a Program Manager will be measured through:

* Quality and timeliness of mission reviews SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR.

* Adherence to mission budget and timelines.

* Effective risk management and issue resolution.

* Successful launch and on-orbit performance of the spacecraft.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience in program/project management, ideally in aerospace, space systems, or other high-complexity engineering domains.

* Strong technical background with the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers across subsystems.

* Proven experience managing budgets, schedules, and risks for multi-stakeholder projects.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Familiarity with space mission lifecycles (concept, design, manufacturing, integration, testing, launch, operations) is highly desirable.

* PMP/Prince2 or similar certification is a plus.

**Benefits**:

Health insurance coverage

Unlimited leaves & flexible working hours

Role-based remote work and work-from-home benefit

Relocation assistance

Professional Mental Wellness Services

Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)

Employee Stock Options for all hires

  

**About Pixxel**

Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.

Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.

Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.

Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.

Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.

**Culture**

Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.  
Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Description**
**Job Summary**
The Professional Services Program Manager will lead services programs and projects as part of the delivery cycle, including handling all deployment resources and ensuring that all deliverables are met and delivered on-time and under budget. The Program Manager will drive customer deployment programs and projects including program, process initiatives, as well as partner with IT on systems and infrastructure processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Determine project partners and team structure/organization partners will include technical and business resources
* In conjunction with project partners, help ensure the definition of project scope, requirements, and deliverables
* Develop project timeline and landmarks using appropriate tools and techniques
* Build and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
* Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities and tasks
* Run day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope
* Work on services operational projects that target new services IP delivery, partner communications, scheduling, etc.
* Review deliverables prepared by team before passing to client
* Effectively apply Palo Alto Networks Project Management methodology and implement project standards
* Minimize our exposure and risk on all projects
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately
* Track and report team hours and expenses on a weekly basis
* Provide Executive Dashboards on overall project/program status
* Mentor project managers and project coordinators

**Requirements**

* BS in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or equivalent education/training/experience
* 8+ years of related work experience or leading complex projects desired
* Analyze project profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates, and utilization
* Strong proficiency with project management software, such as Microsoft Project and SmartSheets
* Good presentation skills including written, oral, presentation
* Good organizational skills including tool utilization (spreadsheets, project management tools, mind maps), information collection, attention to detail, and prioritization
* Strong interpersonal skills including appreciation and the ability to elicit collaboration from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments
* Flexible to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines; able to promptly and expertly react to project adjustments and alterations
* Experience managing large scale (Global) deployments with multiple projects, teams and resources
* Project Management Institute PMP(r) certification or equivalent a plus
* Experience with Google’s G Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides) is a plus

**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

66fdc27e.title: Program Manager
66fdc27e.description:
**Skills**
:
**Program Manager**

**Exp**
: 12-15+

**Domain**
: IT Network and Infrastructure

**Key responsibilities**

**Programme delivery**

* Lead multiple concurrent network programmes (refresh, migration, greenfield, decommission) from mobilisation through to closure and handover.
* Build integrated programme plans covering site surveys, staging, change windows, cutovers, rollback and post-migration hypercare.
* Track progress against milestones and devices/sites completed; recover slippage early through re-planning and resource reallocation.

**Oversee Field operations and resourcing**

* Oversee the Plan and dispatch field engineers (L1) across multiple countries, balancing dedicated, standby and on-demand callout models.
* Implementing Onboarding the FE and subcontractors: site access, inductions, security vetting, tooling and documentation.
* Manage logistics for equipment staging, shipping, onsite storage and returns, including coordination with warehouse and depot teams.
* Make sure engineers have complete site packs (rack elevations, port maps, cabling schedules, labelling standards, contacts) before each visit.

**Client and stakeholder management**

* Act as the primary delivery contact for the client's programme and account teams.
* Run weekly status calls and produce clear status reports and dashboards for client senior management.
* Manage escalations calmly and quickly, with clear ownership, actions and timelines.
* Build trusted relationships with end-customer site contacts, facilities teams and local IT.

**Commercial and financial control**

* Identify and raise change requests for out-of-scope work, aborted visits, additional site days and extra materials.

**Governance, risk and quality**

* Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and lead mitigation actions.
* Enforce health and safety, site access and data-handling requirements on every site.
* Make sure work is evidenced: photos, test results, as-built documentation and signed acceptance forms.
* Run lessons-learned reviews and continuously improve runbooks, templates and engineer checklists.

**Skills and experience**

**Essential**

* 10+ years in IT delivery, including at least 4 years managing network infrastructure programmes or projects.
* Proven delivery of multi-site network refresh, migration or rollout programmes, ideally across more than one country.
* Solid working knowledge of enterprise networking: LAN/WAN, switching and routing, Wi-Fi, firewalls, SD-WAN, structured cabling and data centre racking.
* Experience managing field engineering teams and third-party subcontractors.
* Strong commercial awareness: budgets, rate cards, POs, change control and margin.
* Confident with client senior stakeholders; clear written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable with ITSM and change processes (ITIL, ServiceNow or similar).
* Proficient with MS Project or equivalent, Excel and reporting tools (Power BI desirable).
* Willing to travel and to support out-of-hours change windows when needed.

**Desirable**

* Experience working as a delivery partner to a global system integrator (for example Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Accenture or similar).
* Exposure to manufacturing, OT or regulated environments.
* Familiarity with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Palo Alto or Fortinet hardware rollouts.
* Data centre decommissioning, asset disposal or IT asset management experience.

**Qualifications and certifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or MSP (one or more preferred).
* ITIL v4 Foundation.
* CCNA or equivalent networking certification (desirable).
* Degree in IT, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

202c513f.title: Advisory Solution Consultant (AI)
202c513f.description:
***Job Title: Senior AI Technical Consultant***  
***Company: Aximm LLC***  
***Location: Remote***  
***Job Type: Full Time***  
***Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)***  
***Department: AI & Engineering***  
***Compensation: $40 to $50 per hour during onboarding, followed by $3,000 to $4,000 monthly base salary plus project based bonuses***  
***Experience Required: 7+ years in Software Engineering and 5+ years in AI/ML Engineering***  
***Start Date: Immediate***  
***Prerequisite: Exceptional spoken English proficiency (CEFR C1 minimum, near C2 preferred), strong client facing communication skills, and proven experience in production AI/ML and Agentic AI applications.***

**Job Overview**

Aximm LLC is seeking an experienced Senior AI Technical Consultant with a strong background in Software Engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

This is a client facing technical role focused on participating in technical interviews, discussions, and evaluations with U.S. based clients. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical expertise, understand client requirements, propose practical solutions, and collaborate with internal engineering teams to support project acquisition.

The ideal candidate combines extensive hands on engineering experience, advanced AI expertise, exceptional spoken English, and strong interpersonal and client communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in technical interviews, evaluations, and discussions with prospective U.S. based clients.
* Demonstrate expertise in Software Engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Understand client requirements, identify technical challenges, and propose scalable and practical solutions.
* Provide technical consulting on software architecture, LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and automated workflows.
* Explain technical concepts, architectural decisions, implementation strategies, and technical tradeoffs confidently.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams to evaluate requirements, design solutions, and support project acquisition.
* Represent Aximm LLC professionally and establish technical credibility with clients and stakeholders.

**Required QualificationsSoftware Engineering**

* More than 7 years of professional software engineering experience, including production application development.
* Strong proficiency in Python, backend development, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases, and software architecture.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of system design, scalability, application development, testing, and deployment.

**AI/ML and Generative AI**

* More than 5 years of professional AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, and deploying production AI solutions.
* Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
* Hands on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit learn, or comparable frameworks.
* Practical experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* Understanding of production AI architecture, performance, reliability, and evaluation.

**Agentic AI**

* Hands on experience developing AI agents, tool calling, workflow automation, and multi step task execution.
* Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Microsoft AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar frameworks.
* Understanding of multi agent systems, orchestration, memory management, human in the loop workflows, evaluation, observability, security, and deployment.
* Ability to confidently explain Agentic AI architectures, implementation strategies, and technical tradeoffs.

**English and Communication Skills**

* Minimum C1 level spoken English, with near C2 proficiency strongly preferred.
* Excellent verbal fluency, pronunciation, listening comprehension, and spontaneous conversational ability.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly, naturally, and confidently.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, problem solving, and relationship building skills.
* Confidence in handling challenging technical discussions and communicating with U.S. based clients.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of direct experience working with U.S. based clients.
* Experience in technical consulting, presales engineering, solution architecture, client facing technical interviews, or business development support.
* Familiarity with U.S. business culture and professional communication expectations.
* Production experience with enterprise AI applications, multi agent systems, AI workflow automation, MLOps, or LLMOps.
* Familiarity with AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI.
* Proven contribution to successful client engagements and project acquisition.
* Compensation StructureOnboarding and Evaluation
* Compensation of $40 to $50 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.
* The onboarding period is paid and has no fixed duration. Candidates will be evaluated on technical expertise, English communication, client interview performance, and engineering collaboration.
* Successful candidates will transition to the ongoing compensation structure following management approval.

**Ongoing Compensation**

* Monthly Base Salary: $3,000 to $4,500 USD, subject to final confirmation based on qualifications and performance.
* Project Bonus: Additional $500 USD per month for each qualifying ongoing client project.
* Project bonuses are cumulative and recurring for as long as qualifying projects remain active, subject to company eligibility and verification requirements. There is no predetermined cap on qualifying project bonuses.

**Work Schedule**

* Fully remote position.
* Working hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).
* Candidates must be able to accommodate the schedule consistently and participate in client meetings, technical interviews, and internal collaboration during working hours.

**Candidate Evaluation Process**

* Candidates will undergo an experience review, spoken English assessment, technical interview, client interview simulation, and final management interview.
* The evaluation will assess technical expertise, practical engineering experience, AI/ML and Agentic AI knowledge, communication skills, client facing confidence, professionalism, teamwork, and overall suitability.
* Successful candidates will subsequently enter the paid onboarding and evaluation period.

**Ideal Candidate**

* An experienced software engineer and AI specialist with strong hands on experience in Software Engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, combined with exceptional spoken English, confidence, professionalism, and the ability to represent the company effectively in client facing technical discussions.
* Candidates must be capable of explaining complex technical concepts, answering spontaneous questions, proposing practical solutions, and building technical credibility with U.S. based clients.

Application

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their software engineering experience, AI/ML expertise, Generative AI and Agentic AI projects, cloud technologies, production deployment experience, and client facing experience

Pay: ₹2,800.00 - ₹3,500.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

a5ce7ff0.title: CIS Presales Solution Architect
a5ce7ff0.description:
**About The Role**
CIS Presales Solutions, you will make an impact by shaping and driving winnable, differentiated infrastructure solutions across Managed Services and Digital Transformation pursuits for clients in every vertical. You will be a valued member of the Cloud, Infrastructure and Security (CIS) Services Solution Group team and work collaboratively with onsite sales, solutions and delivery teams, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Take end-to-end responsibility for solution and commercial creation and integration, including running scoping workshops, questionnaires and solution discussions.
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to design differentiated, winnable solutions that meet customer requirements.
* Develop winning themes, SWOT and competitor analysis, and reusable bid components to maximise pursuit efficiency.
* Lead solution workshops, MVD/CAS sessions, due diligence and TPA engagements, interfacing directly with clients and advisors.
* Manage and mentor a team of junior and mid-level solution managers.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai or Bangalore, India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Strong techno-commercial capability with proven customer interaction and solution presentation skills.
* Solid IT infrastructure understanding across Compute (on-prem and cloud), Network, Security, End User and Service Management, including Managed Services and Digital Transformation.
* Knowledge of pricing models, IT spend analysis, business case development, and TCO and ROI analysis.
* Familiarity with service assurance and automation tools and ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Proven track record of delivering complex solutions in a fast-paced environment with strong problem-solving skills.

**These will help you succeed**

* Awareness of industry IT trends and analyst/TPA reports such as Gartner, Everest, Forrester, ISG, BCG, HfS and IDC.
* Experience in cross-cultural and leading global outsourcing organisations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* A flexible, self-motivated, can-do approach with the ability to work well under pressure.
* Flexibility to accommodate short domestic and international business travel.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

f5c7a0b2.title: Senior Advisory Specialist Solutions Consultant
f5c7a0b2.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
You’re the storyteller and solutionist in the room. You show customers how EmployeeWorks gives every employee one AI front door to find answers and get work done across business systems, and how HRSD connects HR cases, knowledge and employee journeys—then you find the path to production. Your focus splits evenly across both. You lead complex sales cycles independently and mentor other Solution Consultants. You focus on customers across India, with light engagement across Asia Pacific.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Act as the EmployeeWorks, HRSD and AI expert for Account Executives and Senior Solution Sales Executives, leading deal strategy across complex sales cycles.
* Lead discovery workshops with IT, HR and executive stakeholders to uncover business challenges, HR processes, technical environments and success criteria.
* Deliver persona- and value-based demonstrations that explain, by showing, how EmployeeWorks and HRSD find answers and get work done for employees.
* Facilitate technical and architectural workshops covering AI approach, integrations and platform architecture in the customer’s ServiceNow environment.
* Design, build and lead end-to-end proof-of-concept engagements with clear success criteria and a credible path to production.
* Partner with Business Value Services to build data-driven business cases, prioritise use cases and articulate measurable ROI.
* Guide strategic programs in top accounts, including roadmap alignment, employee journey mapping and outcome planning.
* Document requirements for a clean handover to Customer Success, and feed customer and competitive insights to Product Management.
* Mentor and coach Solution Consultants, and share best practices and reusable assets across the team.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* 7+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience supporting enterprise application platforms.
* Experience applying and evaluating AI in enterprise environments, including automation, AI-powered tools and data-driven insights.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture and RESTful APIs, and proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or deep technical experience with other enterprise cloud software. Familiarity with RPA, iPaaS and low-code platforms; scripting is a plus.
* Deep understanding of HR processes and employee service delivery, or experience with HCM or ERP systems or HR and workplace transformation.
* A track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and proofs of concept independently, and of mentoring other consultants.
* Executive-level storytelling and presentation skills, with strong territory and pipeline management alongside sales counterparts.
* Travel up to 25%.

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

68c14de8.title: Manager - HCM Solutions | Functional Pre-sales
68c14de8.description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
  
  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**Location**
Bangalore or Mumbai, India (Field / Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience**
6 – 12 years
  
  
**Skills**

* HCM (Human Capital Management) solution consulting
* Functional pre-sales / solution consulting
* Discovery workshops and business requirements documentation
* Process mapping and process flow design
* RFP (Request for Proposal) response development
* Product demonstrations to enterprise prospects
* Value-based selling
* Solution design artefacts — context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions
* HR business processes and workforce management domain knowledge
* C-level stakeholder engagement
* Cross-industry enterprise solutioning

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of legacy ERP HR modules and competing SaaS HCM platforms (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday) for competitive positioning
* HRBP (HR Business Partner) experience

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct discovery workshops with enterprise prospects to formulate and document business requirements, HR processes, procedures, and work practices.

4a6631f3.title: Solutions Engineer III
4a6631f3.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**About the Company:**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.

**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives

* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.

* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

**How you’ll do it:**

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN, NGINX
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, CICD.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Expert in one or more programming languages like Python, Golang, JavaScript. Linux Scripting

**What you’ll bring:**

* 10 + years of related industry experience
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus
* Hybrid Multicloud App Security & Delivery for the AI Era
* Unified delivery & security for applications, APIs, & AI workloads across any infrastructure, trusted by 85% of the Fortune 500.

**Enterprise Performance**

Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise technologies across supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and IT operations. Deloitte’s practitioners bring industry insight and implementation experience to help organizations improve operations, enhance performance, and drive meaningful outcomes across complex transformation programs.

As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

As a Consultant, in the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:

* Supporting Oracle Supply Chain Management implementations across modules such as Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, Work in Process, Advanced Pricing, Services, Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Costing
* Participating in project activities including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional design, configuration, and testing

The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Shift Timings:** 24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3-6 years of experience in Oracle Supply Chain Management full-cycle implementation as a team member or lead

83d39725.description:
**About The Team**
Cisco Webex Customer Experience is building Connected Intelligence: an operating model that brings customer interactions, human and AI agents, workflows, and enterprise systems together. It is organised around four pillars: an intelligent front door, context-driven orchestration, an extensible AI-native platform, and trust and security by design.
  
  
As an AI Solutions Consultant, you will help make this approach real through working demonstrations, customer prototypes, integrations, and repeatable use cases. You will work alongside AI Solution Consultants, Forward Deployed Engineers, account teams, partners, product managers, and engineering teams.
  
  
You will translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions using APIs, webhooks, enterprise systems, AI Agent Studio, and modern AI application-development practices. You will help move ideas from concept to validated use case, while building the technical depth required to support production deployments over time.
  
  
You will deliver three outcomes from each engagement: a working solution, evidence that the use case creates customer value, and a reusable implementation pattern.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate customer use cases and solution designs into technical build plans and working prototypes.
* Build integrations using Python, Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and enterprise platforms.
* Configure and develop conversational AI and workflow experiences using Webex AI capabilities and Webex AI Agent Studio.
* Connect AI experiences to Salesforce, ServiceNow, CRM platforms, contact-centre systems, knowledge sources, and enterprise APIs.
* Develop use cases involving AI agents, voice experiences, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and real-time analytics where appropriate.
* Create customer demonstrations, technical prototypes, pilots, and proof-of-concept solutions.
* Map data flows, system dependencies, events, actions, error conditions, and human hand-offs.
* Apply practical controls for security, privacy, access, observability, testing, and operational reliability.
* Test integrations and AI experiences for accuracy, latency, resilience, usability, and appropriate escalation.
* Instrument solutions so customer and internal teams can measure usage, quality, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Troubleshoot integration, configuration, data, and AI behaviour issues with support from senior engineers and product teams.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions, technical workshops, design reviews, and pilot readouts.
* Work with AI Solution Consultants and FDEs to refine requirements and prepare solutions for production deployment.
* Capture product gaps and implementation lessons with clear technical detail and customer impact.
* Document reusable integrations, configuration patterns, use cases, demonstrations, and troubleshooting methods.
* Contribute to internal enablement, solution libraries, reference architectures, and pre-built assets.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience building software, integrations, automation, or enterprise technology solutions; demonstrated technical ability may substitute for tenure.
* Hands-on experience with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or a comparable programming language.
* Experience working with APIs, webhooks, authentication, data transformation, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with Git, debugging, testing, logging, and basic software-development practices.
* Familiarity with at least one major LLM ecosystem or AI application-development framework.
* Understanding of conversational AI, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, or workflow automation.
* Ability to read technical documentation and learn unfamiliar platforms quickly.
* Experience working with customers, internal stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel approximately 15 to 25 percent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, contact-centre operations, or customer-experience technology.
* Experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, IVR platforms, call-routing systems, knowledge bases, or enterprise data platforms.
* Familiarity with Cisco Webex Customer Experience products and services.
* Experience building conversational or voice-agent prototypes.
* Experience with cloud platforms, event-driven integrations, OAuth, queues, or serverless workflows.
* Familiarity with observability, automated testing, security controls, and production-readiness practices.
* Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, demonstrations, or reusable code assets.

Skills and Attributes
  
  

* Builder mindset with a bias towards creating working software.
* Able to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear technical next step.
* Comfortable learning by doing and working across unfamiliar systems.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Understands the difference between a convincing demo and a dependable solution.
* Takes ownership while knowing when to involve senior engineers, FDEs, or product teams.
* Communicates technical issues clearly and directly.
* Pays attention to detail across data, configuration, testing, and user experience.
* Interested in both the customer problem and the technical implementation.
* Collaborative, curious, pragmatic, and committed to continuous learning.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

ec3fe256.description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a talented GenAI Solution Architect with strong experience in RAG and MCP connectors. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing scalable web applications, integrating backend services, and ensuring seamless user experiences.

  

* **Role: GenAI Solution Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Owns end-to-end technical direction and client alignment for the agentic AI platform.
* Primary technical interface with the client, translating business requirements into architecture spanning RAG pipelines, MCP connectors, and hybrid orchestration across Appian, ERP, DealCloud, Backstop CRM, Snowflake, and Graph DB.
* Application development using Claude Code(environment)
* Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embedding, Pinecone indexing, retrieval
* Implement retrieval strategies including semantic search
* Build MCP connectors exposing system APIs as agent-callable tools (read and write)
* Contribute to agent orchestration: intent routing (RAG vs MCP vs workflow)
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Lead architecture across all AI layers: RAG, MCP connectors (action/data), agent orchestration
* Define integration strategy leveraging existing client APIs, minimising custom build
* Drive MCP connector design for Appian, ERP, DealCloud, Backstop, Snowflake, Graph DB
* Own RAG pipeline decisions: chunking strategy, embedding model, Pinecone retrieval, re-ranking
* Collaborate with client stakeholders (business + IT) to validate use cases guide the offshore team (AI/ML engineers, data engineers)
* 8 to 12 years software/data engineering
* 2+ years LLM/GenAI applications
* Strong Programming skills (Python); LlamaIndex and/or LangChain in production RAG systems
* Vector databases, Pinecone preferred
* MCP / tool-calling patterns; FASTMCP experience a significant plus
* Chunking strategies, overlap settings, metadata tagging
* Vibe coding and prompt engineering experience
* Knowledge of Git-CLI/Github
* Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes (AKS)containerization
* ReactJS experience is good to have
* Python FastAPI experience is also good to have.
* Python scripting for data processing, file parsing (PDFs, Office docs) good to have.
* ETL/ELT patterns and transformation tools good to have
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

2774b1cc.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Security
2774b1cc.description:
**Overview**

Do you want to help some of Microsoft’s largest global customers strengthen their cyber defenses and modernize security for the cloud and AI era? The International Customer Success Unit (iCSU) connects global customer strategy with execution in downstream locations outside customer headquarters. You will work across geographic and organizational boundaries to help customers realize measurable value from their Microsoft security investments.

As a Customer Solution Architect for Azure Security, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and accountable technical owner for priority security outcomes. You will lead architecture and adoption engagements across Azure security, cloud security posture management, security operations, threat protection, identity integration, and secure AI scenarios. You will combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership to remove blockers, guide solutions into production, and connect delivery progress to customer value, consumption, and long-term success.

This opportunity will allow you to deepen your Azure Security expertise, lead complex global engagements, strengthen your business and consulting acumen, and scale your impact through repeatable delivery, partners, and cross-Microsoft orchestration. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 40% from home, aligned to customer and business needs.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build trusted relationships with customer security leaders, enterprise architects, and technical decision makers; understand their security priorities, regulatory context, and technical landscape; and translate these into secure, pragmatic Azure roadmaps.

* Lead architecture design sessions, technical workshops, proof-of-concepts, and implementation guidance for Azure Security solutions, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, cloud workload protection, security posture management, network security, governance, and related identity and threat-protection integrations.

* Own end-to-end technical delivery outcomes for assigned engagements by defining success criteria, maintaining an integrated delivery plan, driving committed milestones to close, proactively escalating blockers, and ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and operationally ready.

* Help customers modernize security operations and secure their cloud and AI estate by applying Zero Trust, secure-by-design, Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected security guidance, and Microsoft reference architectures.

* Drive adoption, usage, and business impact by identifying next-best actions and follow-on opportunities from each engagement, supporting consumption and pipeline outcomes, aligning technical progress to customer business value.

* Orchestrate across CSAMs, account teams, Security Specialists, engineering, FastTrack, Global Delivery, Factory, services, partners, and cross-solution CSAs to deliver a connected One Microsoft customer experience.

* Act as the Voice of the Customer by capturing product feedback and technical blockers, contributing reusable assets and best practices, maintaining role-aligned readiness and certifications, and sharing expertise through customer and technical communities.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting; OR Master's Degree in a related field AND 3+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, product development, or related experience; OR equivalent experience.

* Experience leading customer-facing security architecture, technical consulting, or delivery engagements for enterprise cloud environments.

* Hands-on knowledge across Azure security domains such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, cloud workload protection, security posture management, network security, identity, governance, security operations, or incident response.

* Ability to lead technical discussions with security leaders, enterprise architects, IT management, developers, and operational teams, and to translate security architecture decisions into customer and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting; OR Master's Degree in a related field AND 6+ years relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.

* 4+ years experience in a customer-facing role and 4+ years experience working on technical projects.

* Relevant Microsoft or industry certifications in Azure, cloud architecture, or cybersecurity.

* Experience with hybrid or multicloud security, security governance and data access, modern SOC architecture, incident response, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, or regulated enterprise environments.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. **Debug and Test:** Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

* Analyse business, functional, technical, and data requirements, translating them into scalable, secure, and supportable solution architectures.

* Support engineering teams by providing technical guidance, design assurance, and pragmatic decision-making throughout delivery. Identify and manage architectural risks, dependencies, assumptions, and technical debt, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are in place.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of DataBridge capabilities, architecture practices, engineering standards, delivery processes, and reusable solution patterns. Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and solution assessments to help inform architectural and strategic decisions.
Promote effective ways of working across the organisation, applying knowledge of Agile delivery, Business Process Management (BPM), ITIL service management, and project delivery frameworks such as PRINCE2.

d0d55b64.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Automotive and Manufacturing, AWS Industries
d0d55b64.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the world's largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Be great fun to work with.
  
  
At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
  
  
Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
* Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
* Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
* Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.
* Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
* Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
* Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally

A day in the life
  
  

* Understand customer needs and technical challenges, and design AI-enabled cloud solutions that improve their business outcomes.
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience in IoT, Automotive or Manufacturing domain

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**The Position**
**We are looking for a technically strong Solution Architect who is excited about building modern cloud and AI-enabled solutions for Pharma R&D.**
**You will work with senior architects, product teams, engineers, data scientists and business experts to design and deliver solutions that combine enterprise data and content, cloud technologies, Generative AI and emerging agentic capabilities.**
**This role is suited to someone with strong engineering and architecture foundations who can own architecture for defined solutions and grow into broader architecture responsibility over time.**
**The Opportunity**
**As a Solution Architect, you will:**

* Design end-to-end solution architectures for products, use cases and technical capabilities, working with senior architects on broader cross-product decisions
* Translate business and technical requirements into practical architectures across applications, APIs, integration, cloud, data, security and operational considerations
* Design and contribute to Generative AI and agentic solutions, including LLM applications, retrieval and grounding, agentic workflows, tool integration and human-in-the-loop patterns
* Apply strong cloud engineering principles across services, APIs, data stores, identity and access management, resilience and observability
* Define key non-functional requirements, interfaces, data flows and architecture decisions

* Participate actively in architecture reviews, prototypes, technical spikes and implementation discussions

* Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, product teams and domain experts from solution discovery through deployment and production
* Identify technical risks early, communicate clearly and take ownership for helping teams resolve them

**Who You Are**
**You combine strong technical fundamentals with architectural thinking, curiosity and a desire to grow into broader technical leadership.**
**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in enterprise software architecture, with at least 1+ years designing and deploying production-grade Generative AI / Agentic systems at scale
* Good practical understanding of cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS
* Practical experience building or integrating Generative AI / LLM-enabled applications
* Understanding of modern AI patterns such as RAG, vector/semantic search, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt/context management and AI evaluation
* Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns, distributed applications, data stores and security
* Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and observability
* Ability to consider reliability, scalability, performance, security and cost when making technical decisions
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical outcomes
* Demonstrated curiosity and ability to stay current with developments in Generative AI, agentic systems, cloud and modern software engineering

**Preferred Experience**
