580d857e.title: Engagement Manager
580d857e.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**Brief about Fractal:**

Fractal is one of the most prominent players in the Artificial Intelligence space. Our mission is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and we bring AI, engineering and design to help the world's most admired Fortune 500® companies. Fractal has consistently been rated one of India's best companies to work for by The Great Place to Work® Institute.

  

Cloud, data and AI are driving digital transformation across every enterprise at an unprecedented pace. We help enterprises harness the power of data on the cloud through architecture consulting, data platforms, business-tech platforms, marketplaces, data governance, MDM, DataOps and AI/MLOps, and we apply AI engineering practices to strengthen each of these areas.

  

**About the Role**

The Engagement Manager is accountable for Fractal's analytics and AI delivery on a Healthcare account, and owns outcomes from the first problem statement to the eventual retirement of each solution. The role combines client leadership, delivery management and technical judgement: you will be the primary contact for offshore delivery teams across multiple locations, the partner to the onshore farming team, a trusted advisor to Senior Directors and VPs of Client, and the person who makes sure every solution is built to last, run and, when the time comes, be replaced. The role also carries an implied farming mandate: growing Fractal's business within the managed portfolio, in conjunction with the onsite ideation team.

  

Success is measured by client NPS, the innovative solutions created, impact on the KPIs most critical to Client and revenue growth from the account, as well as by how well the value of each solution holds up after go-live. Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.

  

**Experience:** 10+ years.

**Location:** Bengaluru preferred; Chennai and Pune and Mumbai also considered, in that order.

**Team:** 50+ professionals across multiple locations.

**Reports to**: Principal Consultant.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Lead the Consulting delivery**

* Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
* Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
* Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
* Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
* Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
* Own engagement P&L, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
* Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
* Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
* Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
* Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
* Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.

  

**Shape and deliver Data & AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle**

* **Ideate:** Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
* **Design:** Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
* **Build:** Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
* **Operate:** Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
* **Sunset:** Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.

  

**Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening**

* Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
* Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
* Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractal's footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
* Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio. **Technical Skills**
* Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
* Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
* Familiarity with the client's native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI, Azure and related components, enough to guide solution design, technical conversations and delivery on it.
* Fluency in GenAI: how GenAI applications are designed, built, evaluated, governed and run, and where they do and do not fit a business problem.
* Ability to hold credible conversations with technical stakeholders and to translate business requirements into technical language and solution designs that BI, engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI teams can act on.
* Understanding of how analytics solutions are run and retired: monitoring, model and data drift, cost of ownership, support and decommissioning.
* Knowledge of a variety of advanced analytics and machine learning techniques (for example segmentation and forecasting), and the ability to evaluate and bring in new techniques that add value for clients.

• Ability to design and review new solution concepts, with a record of leading the delivery of high-impact analytics solutions and programs for global clients. • Functional familiarity across one or more of the areas our use cases span: the enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement, with the ability to apply domain and analytics knowledge to them. • Experience designing KPI frameworks and executive dashboards that make performance measurable and decisions data-driven.

* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps delivery practices and how to apply them to analytics and BI programs.

  

**Non-Technical Skills**

* Exceptional consulting skills with a proven track record of delivering high-value solutions. Ability to Engages stakeholders, spots likely business problems, builds compelling POVs for execution roadmaps that grow Fractal's business.
* Executive presence, with a track record of engaging at Senior Director and VP level, the ability to influence and engage senior client and internal stakeholders, and the ability to drive senior groups to conclusions.
* Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: structures ambiguous business problems clearly, innovates where required and looks beyond the build to long term value and cost of ownership.
* 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in leadership roles, leading teams distributed across multiple locations.
* Excellent project and program management skills, with experience managing multiple work streams and projects at the same time.
* Business acumen to manage revenue profitably and meet financial goals consistently, with the ability to quantify business value for clients and create win-win commercial propositions.

  

**Education Qualification and Certifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Advanced degrees (MBA, MS) or relevant certifications are preferred. Examples include Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, other cloud platform and machine learning project certifications, Lean Six Sigma, and Agile or program management credentials.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

a1957ed7.title: Technical Account Manager
a1957ed7.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role serves as the customer's trusted technical advisor, ensuring the stability, performance, security, and continuous improvement of IT services. The role bridges customer business requirements and technical delivery teams, providing proactive technical governance, risk management, service optimization, and technology roadmap alignment across the customer environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Account Ownership
* Act as the primary technical interface between the customer and internal technical teams.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer's IT infrastructure, architecture, service dependencies, and business priorities.
* Maintain technical account documentation, service inventories, architecture diagrams, and configuration baselines.
* Ensure technical solutions and services remain aligned with customer requirements and contractual commitments.
* Service Performance and Technical Governance
* Monitor service health, availability, capacity, performance, and SLA/KPI compliance.
* Lead technical service reviews and provide insights into service trends, recurring incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Review incident, problem, and change management activities from a technical perspective.
* Coordinate technical escalations, major incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective action plans.
* Identify operational risks, technology obsolescence, vulnerabilities, and end-of-life/end-of-support exposure.
* Proactive Problem Management
* Drive proactive identification and resolution of technical risks before they affect business services.
* Analyze incident trends, monitoring alerts, performance data, and recurring faults.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 engineering and OEM/vendor support teams to resolve complex issues.
* Drive permanent fixes, known-error reduction, and preventive maintenance.
* Review and validate technical recovery plans and service resilience measures.
* Technology Roadmap and Service Improvement
* Develop and maintain a technical roadmap aligned with customer strategy and technology lifecycle requirements.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AI-enabled operations, auto-remediation, and proactive monitoring.
* Recommend architecture optimization, performance enhancements, capacity upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Support service transformation, migration, modernization, and technical debt reduction.
* Track improvement initiatives and demonstrate measurable business and operational benefits.
* Architecture and Technical Solution Support
* Collaborate with solution architects, engineering, presales, and delivery teams on technical designs and solution proposals.
* Review high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, and technical change proposals where appropriate.
* Ensure adherence to architectural standards, security policies, and technical best practices.
* Support RFPs, solution assessments, technology evaluations, and technical due diligence.
* Validate technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, and implementation readiness for new services.
* Change, Transition and Vendor Management
* Provide technical oversight for major changes, upgrades, migrations, and service transitions.
* Review change risks, impact assessments, rollback plans, and implementation outcomes.
* Coordinate with OEMs, carriers, technology partners, and internal engineering teams.
* Ensure technical knowledge transfer, operational readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Track vendor performance and drive resolution of technical dependencies.
* Customer Communication and Reporting
* Present technical service performance, risks, incidents, and improvement plans to customer stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear business impact and mitigation options.
* Maintain technical risk registers, action trackers, service improvement plans, and technology roadmaps.
* Provide recommendations supported by service data, trends, and measurable outcomes.

**About You**
**Technical Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and managed services.
* Working knowledge of networking, routing, switching, WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, and connectivity services.
* Knowledge of UCC technologies, including Cisco, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and enterprise voice/video solutions.
* Understanding of cloud, data center, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure services.
* Familiarity with monitoring and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, SolarWinds, and other enterprise monitoring tools.
* Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, change, configuration, and availability management.
* Ability to analyze technical data, identify trends, and drive root-cause elimination.
* Strong stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Design & Collaboration: Figma, Microsoft Visio, Microsoft Whiteboard, Mural
* UX & Service Design Techniques: Journey Mapping, Service Blueprinting, Storyboarding, Lean Six Sigma
* Platforms: ServiceNow, Microsoft Azure, DevOps, ITIL, AI/Generative AI, Data Analytics
* Project & Workflow Management: Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, MS Planner
* Reporting & Data Visualization: Power BI

You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

757842e9.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Cyber Managed Services Consultant Senior Associate you will support cyber incident management workstreams focused on identifying, analyzing, and resolving security incidents to help protect client systems and data. As a Senior Associate you will build meaningful client connections, anticipate team and client needs, navigate complex situations, and deepen your technical skills while using critical thinking to break down concepts and interpret data into practical recommendations. This role sits within our Advisory practice and within our Cyber, Data & Tech Risk practice, where you will contribute to managed services delivery that supports ongoing monitoring and response efforts.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will help deliver work across Cyber, Data, and Tech Risk Managed Services while collaborating with experienced professionals in a client support setting. You will take part in analyzing incident trends, applying tools and methodologies to solve problems, and reinforcing professional and technical standards as you grow your personal brand and broaden your understanding of the business context.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Responding to cybersecurity incidents by analyzing alerts, triaging events, and coordinating containment and recovery actions
* Reviewing incident evidence from security tools, logs, and network activity to identify root cause and potential impact
* Developing remediation steps and tracking follow-up actions to reduce repeat incidents and strengthen defenses
* Supporting managed service deliverables by monitoring client environments and escalating issues based on severity and timing
* Applying cybersecurity incident management methods, threat detection techniques, and vulnerability insights to resolve complex cases
* Documenting incident details, technical findings, and response actions for client reporting and internal knowledge sharing
* Building client relationships by understanding priorities, adapting recommendations, and communicating technical information clearly
* Mentoring junior team members on incident handling activities, workflow execution, and use of security operations tools

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 3 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Studies, Computer and Information Science, Information CyberSecurity, Information Technology, Management Information Systems
* At least one of the following: One or more certifications aligned to incident response and cyber defense, including GIAC (eg., GCFA, GCIA, GCIH) or equivalent incident response credentials
* Demonstrating cybersecurity incident response experience in managed services environments
* Applying log analysis, digital forensics, and threat detection methods
* Interpreting data to guide remediation recommendations and next steps
* Building client relationships while navigating ambiguity and change
* Mentoring junior team members while maintaining professional standards

**ABOUT WIZARDTALES**

Wizardtales Private Limited works in cloud infrastructure and IT services, bringing together technical expertise and international collaboration to deliver dependable services for our customers.

Our supportive, collaborative culture reflects the German work ethics we value: reliability, punctuality, clear communication, quality and keeping our commitments. We believe ambitious work and a healthy work-life balance belong together.

We offer the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and grow your responsibilities as the business develops.

**YOUR ROLE**

You will connect our German-speaking customers with our technical team, ensuring that requests are understood, priorities are clear and commitments are met.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys service delivery, takes responsibility and follows through without needing constant reminders.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Communicate confidently with customers in German through calls, meetings, emails and ticket updates.
* Make sure every ticket has an owner, a priority and clear next steps, and follow through until resolution.
* Coordinate engineers and colleagues, clarify responsibilities and help remove blockers.
* Prioritize urgent incidents, customer commitments and planned work according to impact and available capacity.
* Identify delays and risks early, manage escalations and keep customers informed.
* Improve workflows, documentation and communication to make service delivery more reliable.
* Give management concise updates on progress, outstanding issues and decisions requiring attention.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* A minimum of five years of relevant industry experience in IT services, managed services, cloud infrastructure or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing customer-facing service delivery and coordinating technical teams.
* Fluent spoken and written German, supported by a German language certificate.
* Strong English communication skills for working with the wider team.
* Experience with ticketing systems, incident management, service commitments and customer escalations.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss IT issues confidently and coordinate effectively with engineers.
* Strong organization, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.
* The ability to work independently and communicate proactively in a remote environment.

Experience supporting German-speaking customers and familiarity with ITIL practices would be an advantage.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Fully remote work from India.
* A respectful, supportive and collaborative team culture.
* An international working environment with German-speaking customers and colleagues.
* Trust, ownership and the opportunity to influence how we work.
* A commitment to healthy work-life balance, realistic planning and sustainable workloads.
* Opportunities to learn, develop professionally and grow your responsibilities with the business.

Apply with the button on this page.

42c9418e.title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager
42c9418e.description:
You Will Own Delivery, Client Relationships, and Technical Estimates

MTechZilla is a custom software development company. We build web, mobile, cloud, and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe. Our team of 30+ has delivered 40+ products.

You will own the technical estimate behind every quotation we send, and the delivery of the projects that come out of those quotations. You will also be the person clients come to with their questions, from the first discovery call through the final release.

You need to be a former engineer who can design and estimate a solution, and organized enough to run several client projects at once without anything slipping.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

Delivering every project on time, on budget, and at margin

* Own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent client projects, from kickoff to release and handover.
* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Keep plans, milestones, budgets, and timelines current as priorities shift.
* Track risks, blockers, and dependencies every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Manage scope and turn change requests into approved, billable change orders.
* Coordinate with QA on test plans and release checklists so every release is ready before a client sees it.
* Escalate in writing, before the deadline, when something outside your control puts a milestone at risk.

Manage client relationships

* Act as the main delivery contact for clients across time zones.
* Answer your clients’ questions, technical and non-technical: architecture, feasibility, timelines, costs, scope, and how we work.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.
* Run status reviews and sprint demos, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Present delivery status, risks, and roadmaps to client founders and executives.
* Understand each client’s business and propose technical solutions to their problems.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

Turning client briefs into requirements developers can build from

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features and maintain roadmaps based on business value, effort, and risk.

Design solutions and own estimates for new leads

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead’s technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations, and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation template: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones, and timeline.
* Know what each role on a project costs in the market, so the team you propose in a quotation is priced correctly. Margins are already set; you make sure the inputs are right.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client’s budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

Build delivery processes and documentation that scale

* Run projects in Jira and keep documentation in Confluence: requirements, architecture decisions, release notes, and handover notes.
* Set the documentation standard that every project follows.
* Build a reusable estimation model from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Define and improve our processes for sprints, QA gates, releases, and client reporting.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk, and decisions needed.

Leading and growing the engineering team

* Lead the developers, team leads, and contractors on your projects, and keep them aligned on priorities.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Collaborate with business, marketing, sales, QA, HR, and client teams.
* Take part in hiring, interviews, and decisions on team structure.

Technical Skills You Need

You do not need to write production code every day. You do need to design a system, judge whether a developer’s estimate is realistic, and hold your own with a client’s CTO.

* At least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into lead or delivery roles.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps, and notifications.
* Working knowledge of security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD, and architecture diagrams.

Experience and Qualifications:

Required

* 5 to 6 years of total experience, including at least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* A track record of estimating software projects, with examples of estimates compared to actual delivery.
* Experience leading delivery, projects, or an engineering team.
* Experience running more than one software project at the same time.
* Experience working directly with US or European clients.
* A track record of owning end-to-end delivery and independently driving process improvements.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, release planning, and QA coordination.
* Daily, hands-on use of Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of market salaries and rates for engineering roles in India.
* Clear written English for estimates, PRDs, and status reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience in a software services company, agency, or consulting firm, especially on fixed-price projects.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment, or logistics.
* Ability to create wireframes, workflow diagrams, and POC briefs.
* Experience with Claude and other AI tools.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Sophos, and other IT tools for setting up the right security configurations.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 6 Months

* You produce quotations and estimates for new leads without the CEO filling in technical or timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member could pick up and work from.
* We have an estimation model built from at least 10 past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Your Role
  
  
Lead end-to-end delivery of customer engagements from scoping through execution and renewal. Serve as the primary contact for client stakeholders while managing cross-functional teams to ensure on-time, in-scope delivery aligned to business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own services SOW: scope, assumptions, deliverables, acceptance criteria
* Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities with Sales and Customer Success
* Define and track value metrics: adoption, performance, time-to-value, business impact
* Drive user adoption and change management with client sponsors

**Risk & Quality Management**

* Maintain consolidated view of project health: schedule, scope, budget, risks, satisfaction
* Anticipate and mitigate delivery risks; manage dependencies across teams
* Enforce best-practice methodologies (agile/hybrid delivery, SDLC, data & AI standards)

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* 7+ years in consulting, professional services, or project management with enterprise customers
* Proven track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations (SaaS, data/analytics, AI/ML, MarTech/CDP)
* Strong stakeholder management with clear, confident communication skills
* Expertise in project management: planning, estimation, risk management, governance
* Experience owning SOWs, budgets, and profitability for services engagements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

b61b2b4c.title: Engagement Manager
b61b2b4c.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Brief About Fractal**
Fractal is one of the most prominent players in the Artificial Intelligence space. Our mission is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and we bring AI, engineering and design to help the world's most admired Fortune 500® companies. Fractal has consistently been rated one of India's best companies to work for by The Great Place to Work® Institute.
  
  
Cloud, data and AI are driving digital transformation across every enterprise at an unprecedented pace. We help enterprises harness the power of data on the cloud through architecture consulting, data platforms, business-tech platforms, marketplaces, data governance, MDM, DataOps and AI/MLOps, and we apply AI engineering practices to strengthen each of these areas.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Engagement Manager is accountable for Fractal's analytics and AI delivery on a Healthcare account, and owns outcomes from the first problem statement to the eventual retirement of each solution. The role combines client leadership, delivery management and technical judgement: you will be the primary contact for offshore delivery teams across multiple locations, the partner to the onshore farming team, a trusted advisor to Senior Directors and VPs of Client, and the person who makes sure every solution is built to last, run and, when the time comes, be replaced. The role also carries an implied farming mandate: growing Fractal's business within the managed portfolio, in conjunction with the onsite ideation team.
  
  
Success is measured by client NPS, the innovative solutions created, impact on the KPIs most critical to Client and revenue growth from the account, as well as by how well the value of each solution holds up after go-live. Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ years.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru preferred; Chennai and Pune and Mumbai also considered, in that order.
  
  
**Team:**
50+ professionals across multiple locations.
  
  
**Reports to**
: Principal Consultant.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Lead the Consulting delivery**

* Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
* Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
* Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
* Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
* Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
* Own engagement P&L, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
* Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
* Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
* Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
* Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
* Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.

**Shape and deliver Data & AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle**

* Ideate: Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
* Design: Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
* Build: Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
* Operate: Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
* Sunset: Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.

**Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening**

* Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
* Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
* Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractal's footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
* Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio. Technical Skills
* Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
* Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
* Familiarity with the client's native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI, Azure and related components, enough to guide solution design, technical conversations and delivery on it.
* Fluency in GenAI: how GenAI applications are designed, built, evaluated, governed and run, and where they do and do not fit a business problem.
* Ability to hold credible conversations with technical stakeholders and to translate business requirements into technical language and solution designs that BI, engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI teams can act on.
* Understanding of how analytics solutions are run and retired: monitoring, model and data drift, cost of ownership, support and decommissioning.
* Knowledge of a variety of advanced analytics and machine learning techniques (for example segmentation and forecasting), and the ability to evaluate and bring in new techniques that add value for clients.
* Ability to design and review new solution concepts, with a record of leading the delivery of high-impact analytics solutions and programs for global clients.
* Functional familiarity across one or more of the areas our use cases span: the enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement, with the ability to apply domain and analytics knowledge to them.
* Experience designing KPI frameworks and executive dashboards that make performance measurable and decisions data-driven.
* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps delivery practices and how to apply them to analytics and BI programs.

**Non-Technical Skills**

* Exceptional consulting skills with a proven track record of delivering high-value solutions. Ability to Engages stakeholders, spots likely business problems, builds compelling POVs for execution roadmaps that grow Fractal's business.
* Executive presence, with a track record of engaging at Senior Director and VP level, the ability to influence and engage senior client and internal stakeholders, and the ability to drive senior groups to conclusions.
* Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: structures ambiguous business problems clearly, innovates where required and looks beyond the build to long term value and cost of ownership.
* 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in leadership roles, leading teams distributed across multiple locations.
* Excellent project and program management skills, with experience managing multiple work streams and projects at the same time.
* Business acumen to manage revenue profitably and meet financial goals consistently, with the ability to quantify business value for clients and create win-win commercial propositions.

**Education Qualification And Certifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Advanced degrees (MBA, MS) or relevant certifications are preferred. Examples include Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, other cloud platform and machine learning project certifications, Lean Six Sigma, and Agile or program management credentials.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Location – Gurgaon

We are looking for dedicated and motivated individuals with strong leadership, organisational and teamwork skills for their Private Markets team based in Gurugram

* CFA, Chartered Accountant, MBA from a top tier business school
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills and experience in client relationship management

Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines.

d7c7b903.description:
**Overview**

Do you want to help build the operating system for Frontier Transformation?

Microsoft Frontier Company helps customers achieve measurable business outcomes through AI, engineering, and transformation at scale. Within Frontier Company Operations, Business Excellence advances its vision through a portfolio of capabilities and organizations, with Delivery Excellence (DE) serving as the AI-native operating system for how we pursue, deliver, govern, and realize customer value, with speed, quality, predictability, and financial discipline built into every engagement.

Execution Engineering is the Intelligence pillar and engineering arm of Delivery Excellence, building the intelligent products, platforms, agents, and experiences that power this operating system.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager with strong program and product management experience, you will own a problem area end-to-end, from customer and user insight to product vision, roadmap, and the cross-functional execution that ships it.

You will partner across business, engineering, and operations to identify opportunities, shape strategy, and deliver intelligent products, platforms, agents, and experiences that drive measurable outcomes. You will be responsible for translating ambiguous challenges into scalable solutions that improve how we pursue opportunities, deliver engagements, govern execution, and realize customer value. This is an individual contributor role.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products, platforms, agents, and experiences, grounded in user needs, telemetry, and business priorities.

* Discover and frame problems: synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market trends into prioritized problem statements and testable hypotheses.

* Define success criteria and outcome metrics (KPIs), and partner with Engineering to build the telemetry needed to measure them.

* Partner with Engineering, Design, and Architecture to translate the roadmap into shippable increments, making clear tradeoffs on scope, sequencing, and value.

* Drive product execution end-to-end, managing dependencies, risks, stakeholder alignment, and delivery from concept through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

* Lead product launch and adoption: Own go-to-market readiness, preview programs, documentation, enablement, and feedback loops, partnering with business, engineering, and operational stakeholders to drive adoption and continuously improve the user experience.

* Champion AI-first and agentic experiences while ensuring quality, security, privacy, compliance, Responsible AI, and operational excellence are built into every solution.

* Drive platform thinking, knowledge capture, and IP reuse by identifying common patterns, shared capabilities, and reusable assets that can scale across products and teams.

* Communicate strategy, progress, and impact to leaders and stakeholders, building consensus in a highly matrixed, global environment.

* Drive user experience, and strong enforcement and adherence to hygiene, security, and compliance requirements of the organization.

* Contribute to organizational strategy, helping shape priorities, operating models, roadmaps, and investment decisions that advance the broader mission of Business Excellence and Delivery Excellence.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, consolidate, and modernize fragmented processes, tools, and experiences into scalable, AI-native capabilities that improve business outcomes

 **Qualifications**

Required / Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree AND c OR equivalent experience.

* 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects or products.

Preferred Qualifications

* Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics, while driving complex cross-functional execution from concept through adoption.

* Experience with AI/GenAI, LLMs, or agentic workflows; DevOps and/or knowledge-management practices; and data-informed decision-making.

* Demonstrated ability to translate customer, user, and business needs into product strategy, requirements, and scalable solutions, balancing user value, business priorities, technical constraints, and operational considerations to achieve measurable outcomes.

* Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority across a global, matrixed organization.

* Responsible for self-development on latest trends/developments in the related role/work profile according to professional development plan.

* Experience leading large-scale organizational change, transformation initiatives, or adoption programs across distributed teams and stakeholder groups

* Must have a proven record of managing and executing work through large vendor teams and outsourced partners.

* Outstanding interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment, inspire teams, and drive execution across diverse stakeholder communities.
* Experience leveraging telemetry, experimentation, user feedback, and business metrics to inform product decisions and measure impact.

  PMP, Scrum (CSM/CSPO), SAFe, ITIL, Product Management, or related certifications are a plus

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. 801028fc.title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Manager-Tech Program Manager
801028fc.description:
**Job Description - Strategy & Transactions**

At **Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T)**, we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.

We work with **C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders** to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.

If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.

**The Team**

Our innovation team turns promising business ideas into working proofs of concept that help leaders decide where to invest. We work directly with practitioners and business sponsors to understand a workflow, identify its highest-value uncertainty, and build the smallest, useful solution that tests it.

We are looking for curious, motivated builders who enjoy learning quickly and succeeding together. Success means credible evidence of business value: faster work, better decisions, improved quality, reduced cost, & a clear finding that an idea should change or stop.

**Work you will do:**

You turn a new or partially defined business ideas into a focused, executable experiment. Working with sponsors, the architect, and engineers, you own the plan and the evidence needed for an investment decision. You keep the team focused across concurrent POCs and remove coordination friction.

You bring curiosity, initiative, and motivation to succeed in two-to-six-week POC cycles. You use harnesses like Claude Code and Codex in approved workflows and verify their outputs.

* Lead intake and discovery; define the user problem, value hypothesis and experimentation approach, baseline, acceptance criteria, scope, and decision date with each sponsor.
* Translate the experiment into a technical delivery plan with rapid iterations, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, and a realistic capacity allocation.
* Coordinate data and environment access, platform support, integration checkpoints, budget visibility, and timely decisions on blockers.
* Protect short delivery cycles: challenge scope growth, sequence the riskiest assumptions first, and keep stakeholder feedback close to the build.
* Run useful reviews and demonstrations; maintain a concise portfolio view of progress, evidence, spend, risks, and next decisions.
* Coordinate POC closure and handoff to engineering teams, with a named receiving owner, technical artifacts, and remaining work.

**What you bring**

* Demonstrated technical program delivery across software, data, or AI workstreams, with enough engineering fluency to challenge assumptions and understand dependencies.
* Experience converting ambiguous business needs into measurable outcomes for a product and coordinating teams under compressed timelines.
* Ability to communicate with broad and diverse stakeholder groups: executives, practitioners, engineers, and platform teams; strong prioritization, decision documentation, and follow-through.
* Working knowledge of cloud deployment, APIs, data contracts, testing, and AI evaluation; fluency with delivery tools such as Jira or GitHub Projects.

**Helpful experience**

Professional services experience, AI native development, and prior engineering experience. C

Technical certifications are useful where supported by a strong delivery record.
  
  
**Qualification Required**

* 9+ Years of hands-on relevant experience

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

29f83424.title: Principal Program Manager, Ship With Amazon
29f83424.description:
**Description**
Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e-commerce. Since Amazon started in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers.
  
  
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our growing team in Amazon Shipping (SWA) organization! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make SWA experience for our shippers seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by product innovation, technology led business excellence, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment.
  
  
You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You have expertise in managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined. You are a strategic thinker who connects technical improvements to business outcomes.
  
  
You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are seeking an innovative, intellectually curious, results-oriented Principal Program Manager to drive broad cross-organizational, cross-regional, critical programs and charter level portfolios in our organization. The Principal PM will operate with complete autonomy and will be in charge of handling all aspects of technical projects within the SWA organization such as Shipper support, Billing & Payment, Claims and Delivery experience domains.
  
  
As a Principal Program Manager, you will
  
  

* Own and drive complex programs and portfolio, stakeholder relationship, program governance, and end-to-end program lifecycle.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, evaluate options and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role. You should also have the ability to coach, and mentor individuals; build a strong cross-functional organization. Be a champion of operational excellence and establish team metrics for that excellence; including a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvement. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to senior leadership. Raise the bar on program management excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.
* Collaborate and influence team members, product, engineering leaders and work with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis. This includes building relationships and identifying with stakeholders across the organization.
* Compile, manage, and report on project and portfolio level metrics, post launch adoption, and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements
* This position requires the ability to operate in ambiguous situations and think outside the box when our customers’ problems may not always have clear solutions. It also requires backbone to lead upward as it will drive program adoption with senior leadership and customers while demonstrating empathy in responding to evolving customer needs.
* Build consensus across VP organizations through effective narratives and presentations, representing complex operational and technical trade-offs clearly
* Manage executive-level escalations with excellent judgment, balancing operational constraints with business priorities
* Establish and own success metrics that connect operational and technical improvements to business outcomes
* Create mechanisms for continuous visibility and proactive risk identification and represent team in Monthly, Quarterly business reviews to translate operational metrics into business impact for executive audiences
* Quantify the business impact of product features, technical improvements and communicate ROI to leadership
* Team Development & Community Building, Drive knowledge sharing, build knowledge artifacts
* Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently
* Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and knowledge sharing
* Raise the bar for program management excellence across Amazon Shipping
* Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations
* Use Generative AI for data analysis, generating insights on technical and business metrics, risks, dependencies and program status management

**You'll Collaborate Closely With**

* Product Management teams defining capabilities and roadmaps, status
* Commercial teams driving enterprise shipper adoption and delivery SLAs
* Engineering organizations building support, claims, billing/payments and delivery tracking platforms
* Operations teams supporting global shipping networks
* Principal Engineers and Architects on technical decisions
* VP-level leadership across multiple organizations

The right candidate will possess a strong product/program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading large programs for software product development, and will have a good technology exposure. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 10+ years of program or project management experience
* 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data and customer insights to drive decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions
* Demonstrated ability to build mechanisms that scale across multiple products, teams, or organizations.
* Experience working across product, engineering, operations and business in a large-scale technology environment.
* Experience delivering high impact projects within scope, time, budget and quality
* Leveraging GenAI for SDLC acceleration and actionable insights

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Microsoft Frontier Company helps customers achieve measurable business outcomes through AI, engineering, and transformation at scale. As a Senior Technical Program Manager with strong program and product management experience, you will own a problem area end-to-end, from customer and user insight to product vision, roadmap, and the cross-functional execution that ships it.
  
  
You will partner across business, engineering, and operations to identify opportunities, shape strategy, and deliver intelligent products, platforms, agents, and experiences that drive measurable outcomes. You will be responsible for translating ambiguous challenges into scalable solutions that improve how we pursue opportunities, deliver engagements, govern execution, and realize customer value. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

460cd46c.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
460cd46c.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences:
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
**Work/Life Balance**
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Inclusive Team Culture**
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
**Mentorship And Career Growth**
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

**Preferred Qualifications**
